dialogues.speaker: Monsieur Os
dialogues.text: Those souls... The shadows of the past lingering here... If we can defeat Boethius, perhaps they too can at last find peace...

response.speaker: Monsieur Os
response.text: Obsession? Delusions? Regardless, the bodies created by the Sebastos offered us a sanctuary to which we could flee.

response.speaker: Monsieur Os
response.text: Just as he hoped, the sea will steal neither our souls nor our lives... But it is because of this that our souls have become all the heavier.

response.speaker: Monsieur Os
response.text: Rather than my kin now being trapped beneath the depths by the Symphony, it is more accurate to say that they, like Boethius, are bound here by their own obsession.

response.speaker: Monsieur Os
response.text: Alright. If there is anything you wish to know, do not hesitate to ask me.
